title: Congratulations, Shenghan! A DSI Doctoral Research Showcase finalist
summary: Shenghan’s telehealth and continuity-of-care paper is a finalist in the 2026 DSI Doctoral Research Showcase. Come hear her present in San Francisco on November 21!
body:
Some lovely news to share: on September 5, we learned that [Shenghan Li](https://carlsonschool.umn.edu/faculty/shenghan-li) was selected as a finalist in the **2026 DSI Doctoral Research Showcase Award** for our paper, “Telehealth and Continuity of Care in Mental Health Care Delivery: Evidence from a U.S. Nationwide Claims Database.” The paper is joint work with Kingshuk K. Sinha.

Congratulations, Shenghan! I’m so happy to see your work recognized and grateful to be part of this project with you. It is especially exciting to see a question we care about—how telehealth shapes continuity of mental health care—getting a wider audience.

If you’ll be at DSI in San Francisco, please come hear Shenghan present and join me in cheering her on!

**Doctoral Research Showcase Award: Finalists**

- **When:** Saturday, November 21, 2026, 1:00–2:30 p.m.
- **Where:** San Francisco Marriott Marquis, 2nd Floor, Foothill C

I hope you’ll stop by for the presentation and discussion.
